newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates firm on fears of shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates firm on fears of shortfall.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates firmed on Monday on heavy buying by spinners who fear a shortfall of good-quality cotton, brokers said.
Broker Nasim Usman said rates were likely to rise on Tuesday for the same reason.
The latest unofficial estimates for this year's crop ranged between 8.5 and 8.8 million 375-lb bales, he said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,375 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the broker said.
